name: Oratorio ~Yakusoku~
source:
September before the cultural festival. Protagonist becomes responsible for his class preparation. There is a good number of pretty girls in the committee as well. Will he create nice memories with girls till the day of the festival on September 23rd?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
九月，文化祭即將到來。主角負責籌備班級活動，籌備委員會中也有不少漂亮的女生。在9月23日文化祭正式舉辦以前，他能否與少女們共同留下美好的回憶？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
